```python
import importlib.util, json, os, sys, tempfile, unittest
from pathlib import Path

REPO_ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
TOOL_PATH = REPO_ROOT / "tools" / "run-delivery.py"

def _load_tool():
    spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("run_delivery_tool", TOOL_PATH)
    module = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
    spec.loader.exec_module(module)
    return module

run_delivery = _load_tool()
```

Careful: `spec.loader.exec_module` executes the module; the module has `if __name__ == "__main__"` guard → the module name is "run_delivery_tool" → not main → no CLI run. Good.
